title: What Dixieland means: syncopated marches
summary: Dickenson thinks the pieces called Dixieland were marches jazzed up with syncopation, different from ragtime.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: What the word "jazz" means: origins, Dixieland and labels
